question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Who would you want to see in future episodes?

nodes.text: You pull with all your strength and...

nodes.speaker: Brett
nodes.text: We're losing ground! Adrian! You're supposed to be unstoppable!

nodes.speaker: Adrian
nodes.text: Adrian... Is... Surprised.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Heh. I think Adrian just met his match!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: All together, now!
Everyone heaves, and the DUDE boys go flying into the mud!

nodes.speaker: Brett
nodes.text: Yuck.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: And there you have it, spring breakers! The men of Centerscore University's Mu Alpha Nu take the first challenge!
Tug-of-War Champion!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Nice!
You shovel food into your mouth, chew, and swallow it down!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Look at $USR! He's a machine!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Hurry up! We need to keep up with him.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: That's it, guys! Don't back down! Don't give up!

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: There! We're done!

nodes.speaker: Adrian
nodes.text: What?! But... I `never` lose an eating contest!
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! But... I [color=#e23b3b][i]never[/i][/color] lose an eating contest!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Today, you do. MAN wins!

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Yay, $USR!
Eating Contest Champion!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Heh. Nothing to it.

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: It was an exciting week of sportsmanship, but in the end, DUDE pulled ahead with the wins!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: So congratulations to the brothers of DUDE, winners and the King of Spring Break!

nodes.speaker: Brett
nodes.text: You know, I feel like we really earned this.

nodes.speaker: Jake
nodes.text: The better men won.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: It's my pleasure to present your fraternity with this check for $20,000! Party on, boys.

nodes.speaker: Adrian
nodes.text: Ha!

nodes.speaker: Fred
nodes.text: We're number one!

nodes.speaker: Brett
nodes.text: Maybe we'll use all that prize money to build a monument to the day we beat MAN down.

nodes.speaker: Jake
nodes.text: Or we could get a private jet and fly back here any time we want.

nodes.speaker: Fred
nodes.text: Or throw the best party any fraternity has `ever` thrown.
nodes.text_bbcode: Or throw the best party any fraternity has [color=#e23b3b][i]ever[/i][/color] thrown.

nodes.speaker: Todd
nodes.text: So many choices...

nodes.speaker: Brett
nodes.text: James, you're lucky you don't have such a terrible burden. I mean, how will we decide?

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. Real smooth, guys.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: This sucks.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Defeat is a bitter, bitter mistress.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: If only it could have been different... If only I had done better...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Yeah? Well, it's `not` different. This is the way things are, $USR.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah? Well, it's [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] different. This is the way things are, $USR.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: It's not like you have some fancy, magic time machine that you can just hop in and go back and fix it all!

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Yeah. We've all got regrets, and you know what we do? We live with them...
Well, that's sort of true... But in this case, you `can` go back and get a better ending!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, that's sort of true... But in this case, you [b]can[/b] go back and get a better ending!

nodes.text: Don't let your bros in MAN down! Give them the great spring break they're hoping for!

args.text: Try again to become the King of Spring Break!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Eeeek! Too hot!
You leap off of the bed of coals.

nodes.speaker: Brett
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! What a wimp.

nodes.speaker: Adrian
nodes.text: Weak. He screams like a little girl who sees a spider and screams because little girls don't like spiders.
One by one, the other brothers drop out until only Adrian is left.

nodes.speaker: Adrian
nodes.text: Adrian wins!

nodes.speaker: Brett
nodes.text: Not much of a competition.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. $USR, I know it hurt, but did you have to scream like that when you jumped off?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Sorry, guys.
Just then, the music cues up, and Hawk jumps onto the main stage.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: All right, TV audience... This is it!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: We're down to the `final challenge` for who will be the King of Spring Break...
nodes.text_bbcode: We're down to the [color=#e23b3b][i]final challenge[/i][/color] for who will be the King of Spring Break...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Who can last the longest standing on this bed of coals?
Hawk pulls away another curtain and reveals a bed of red, hot, glowing coals.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Where does he keep getting these curtains?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: More importantly, where did he get a `bed of coals?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: More importantly, where did he get a [color=#e23b3b][i]bed of coals?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: The ultimate test...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: What does this have to do with spring break?!

nodes.speaker: Fred
nodes.text: Sounds like someone's scared.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Are you saying you `want` to burn your feet to a crisp?
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you saying you [color=#e23b3b][i]want[/i][/color] to burn your feet to a crisp?

nodes.speaker: Jake
nodes.text: Real men aren't afraid of a little pain!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: We're not afraid either.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Come on, $USR, man up!

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: We can do this.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Right. We've just got to stay on there longer than they can.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Just stay focused...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Ready? Let the pain begin!
Everyone steps forward onto the coals...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Ouch! This is `hot!` I've got to use all my will power to stay on these coals!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ouch! This is [color=#e23b3b][i]hot![/i][/color] I've got to use all my will power to stay on these coals!

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Oh. Oh! I'm sorry. I didn't know.

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: She must be a very lucky girl.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Heh.

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Well, good luck in the final event. I'll be cheering for you!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: That could have gone better...

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Mmm!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Wow.

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Uh oh... I think we've attracted some attention.
Vivian points over to where a camera man is filming you.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Uh oh.

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I... Er... Forgot about all those cameras.

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: So? What's wrong with that? It's spring break. This is exactly what people do on spring break.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yeah, but most of them aren't being filmed... Live... On a show that anyone could be watching...
Just then, your phone beeps!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Uh oh. I think I just got a text message...

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Something's going on here.
Vivian grabs your phone out of your hand and reads the text!

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: '$USR, did you really think you could cheat on me while you're on a `TV show`, and I wouldn't find out?'
nodes.text_bbcode: '$USR, did you really think you could cheat on me while you're on a [color=#3b78e2][i]TV show[/i][/color], and I wouldn't find out?'

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: 'You jerk, you jerk, you jerk, it's over.'

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: And... I... Can't read the rest of that out loud.

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: So, $USR, let me guess... This is from your girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: So my follow up question is... Why didn't you tell me `you have a girlfriend?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: So my follow up question is... Why didn't you tell me [color=#3b78e2][i]you have a girlfriend?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: But... It's... Spring break...

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Ugh. Yeah, `some` girls are into cheating, but `I'm` not that kind of girl!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh. Yeah, [color=#3b78e2][i]some[/i][/color] girls are into cheating, but [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] not that kind of girl!

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Look, just forget you ever met me, okay?
Vivian storms away!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I guess I blew that... Thanks a lot, camera guy!

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: What's wrong? I thought...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: It's just...

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Oh, look, forget it. I'm not into playing mind games, okay? If you want some girl that's going to chase you, find someone else.
Vivian storms away!

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: That's a lucky coincidence. If only there was something we could do about that...
Viv leans in closer to you...

nodes.prompt: Viv leans in closer to you...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Viv leans in closer to you...

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: I have to admit, you `are` cute... And just my type.
nodes.text_bbcode: I have to admit, you [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] cute... And just my type.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Viv, I have to tell you something...

nodes.prompt: I have to tell you something...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I have to tell you something...

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Oh really? Because it sure seems like something...

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Are you spreading all kinds of rumors about us? I bet you're telling all your frat boys that we made out.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I... I didn't do that!

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Hee hee! I'm just teasing you. I know how guys are.

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Hitting on you? Come on, I thought guys were supposed to hit on girls.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: An old-fashioned kind of girl, huh?

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: I don't mind being chased a little, that's all I'm saying.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Ugghh... So full! Can't... Eat... Another... Bite!

nodes.speaker: Brett
nodes.text: Ha ha! Weak!

nodes.speaker: Adrian
nodes.text: Adrian `loves` roast pig!
nodes.text_bbcode: Adrian [color=#e23b3b][i]loves[/i][/color] roast pig!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Uuggnnnhhh...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: That's it. If $USR's giving up, so am I. We'll never finish the pig without him.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Yeah. Me too.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Come on! We've already packed away so much of it!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Sorry... Team... Can't... Do... It.
The DUDE frat boys finish off their pig.

nodes.speaker: Jake
nodes.text: Mmmm! Delicious!

nodes.speaker: Brett
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! We win!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Congratulations, DUDE! You take home this win.

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: $USR, are you okay? You look like you're going to be sick...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I'm... Okay.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: All right, let's wrap this event up.
Hawk turns to the camera and smiles.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Ahem. So, congratulations to DUDE!
You paddle out to where the waves are...
When you get out to the right distance, you see your first wave...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Rock and roll.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: To keep it fair, we've got a four-wave limit... That means you'll have your choice of four waves.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Each wave that comes by, you can either catch it or wait for the next one. But you only get four.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: After that, your turn's over, and it's the next guy's turn.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: So if you don't catch a wave by then, you've got to come back, and you'll have no score.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: And if you wipe out, you also get a zero.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: But if you can ride a wave in, we'll give you a score for it, and that'll help your team's total.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Got it.

nodes.title: Day 3
nodes.subtitle: Can you be King of the Luau?

nodes.text: The next day, you and the other brothers get to the beach and find it crowded with spectators and cameras.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Any idea why we had to show up in our swim trunks today?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: I'm no scientist, but I'm guessing we're going in the water...
Suddenly, Hawk jumps on stage, and the music cues up!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: WOO! It's `SPRING BREAK`, and we're back for the final day of 'King of Spring Break'!
nodes.text_bbcode: WOO! It's [color=#e23b3b][i]SPRING BREAK[/i][/color], and we're back for the final day of 'King of Spring Break'!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: It's going to be an action-packed day, so get ready!
Hawk turns to another camera.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: We couldn't crown a King of Spring Break without finding out who the king of the waves is!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Uh oh...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: That's right! Today, we've got a `surfing` competition!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's right! Today, we've got a [color=#e23b3b][i]surfing[/i][/color] competition!

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Surfing? I barely know how to swim...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Okay, so this might not be our strong suit... But how good could DUDE be?

nodes.speaker: Brett
nodes.text: Jake, get the wet suits! Adrian, wax up the epoxy shortboards.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: We might be in trouble.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: `Someone` in this fraternity must have `some` experience surfing!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Someone[/i][/color] in this fraternity must have [color=#e23b3b][i]some[/i][/color] experience surfing!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Well, I went surfing last year when my family went to Florida. I'm no expert, but...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Tell us everything you know!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Okay, okay. Um, first you have to catch a good wave. The waves out there look like they're getting up to six feet.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: The bigger the wave, the harder it'll be to ride it, but the more impressive it'll look, and the more points you'll get if you stay on.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Catch the biggest wave possible, got it.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Wait, that's not what I...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: All right! Time to hit the waves!
Hawk calls out different names as each person steps up.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: James Yamat! You're up!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Let's do this.
James charges into the water and catches a huge wave... But completely wipes out!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Water... Everywhere...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Brett Tanner! Your turn!

nodes.speaker: Brett
nodes.text: This is going to be easy.
Brett waits for two waves, then rides a six foot wave into the shore!

nodes.speaker: Brett
nodes.text: Woo!
You wait for your turn while the rest of the guys try surfing...
Finally, Hawk turns to you.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: $USR! Uh, sorry, man, almost forgot about you. What was your last name?

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: And last up, $USR $LSTNM, it's your turn to hit the waves! MAN is down by 6 points, so you'll need to do something impressive out there!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Gulp.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: So do you know how this works?

nodes.prompt: So do you know how this works?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: So do you know how this works?

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: I can't believe DUDE would stoop so low.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: I believe it. But I know we can take 'em.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Tomorrow's the last day of the competition... Looks like they're going to be jerks until the bitter end.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Then we better be ready to fight.
You pull out your phone.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: You know what? I'm not going to do anything... But a few friends of mine might just want to arrest you for trespassing.

nodes.speaker: Adrian
nodes.text: The cops? Come on, don't be a snitch.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: This is our party, and we're throwing you out.

nodes.speaker: Adrian
nodes.text: Fine, can't fight your own battles, huh? All right, I'll go.

nodes.speaker: Adrian
nodes.text: Good luck hiding behind the cops.
You punch Adrian in the face!

nodes.speaker: Adrian
nodes.text: Ouch!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Not so tough now, are you?

nodes.speaker: Adrian
nodes.text: Oh, I'm still pretty tough.
Adrian tackles you! The two of you hit the ground, and he punches you in the stomach.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Oof!

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Get him off of $USR!
Bryce, Chuck, and James pull Adrian off of you.

nodes.speaker: Adrian
nodes.text: Yeah, you better protect your boy.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Hey, he got a good hit in.

nodes.speaker: Adrian
nodes.text: Lucky shot.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Adrian
nodes.text: Fine. This party's lame anyway.
Adrian turns and leaves.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: But hey, it's time for the party. We'd better head to the club.
You and James head back to the club...
And find it packed!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Looks like we've got this one all locked up.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: We did it! I can't believe there are so many people here.
Across the room, you spot Howard and his girlfriend with some of your friends from Centerscore High.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Hey, Howard! You're in Hawaii?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Hah, dumb question. How's it going?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $USR! What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I'm helping the MAN fraternity win the title of King of Spring Break! We're competing against DUDE.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: But that's a different story. What are `you` doing `here?`
nodes.text_bbcode: But that's a different story. What are [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] doing [color=#e23b3b][i]here?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We're on a school trip!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Ha ha, awesome. When I was at Centerscore, we didn't do anything nearly as fun as go to Hawaii. Hope you two are enjoying yourselves...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Anyway, I have to go supervise. I'll catch you guys later!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Bye, $USR!
The doors are suddenly thrown open, and Hawk appears with the camera crew!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: The Hawk approves of this party.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: After seeing DUDE's dud of a party, I'm officially calling this party the winner!
Party Champion!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Sweet.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: If there's one thing MAN can do, it's throw a party.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: And that's a wrap for tonight.
The cameras click off and Hawk leads them out.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: So what now?

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: We enjoy our party!

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Hey! $USR!
You turn around and see Vivian!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Just something to think about while we're here...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Okay, Lancelot, let's see if you're singing the same tune when that cute little Vivian is all over you.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: What? No way! I've got a girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Sure, sure. But she's not `here.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sure, sure. But she's not [color=#e23b3b][i]here.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I'm not going to cheat on my girlfriend!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: It's not cheating if you're on different land masses.

nodes.prompt: It's not cheating if you're on different land masses.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: It's not cheating if you're on different land masses.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: You'll have a great time.

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Okay, first of all, not all girls are totally boy-crazy.

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: And second of all, I know how guys are. I bet you've only invited `girls` to this party. So how many guys are really going to be there?
nodes.text_bbcode: And second of all, I know how guys are. I bet you've only invited [color=#3b78e2][i]girls[/i][/color] to this party. So how many guys are really going to be there?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: You... Make a good point.

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Hee hee. Sorry, but your party sounds pretty lame. You're going to have to try a `lot` harder if you want to get me there.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hee hee. Sorry, but your party sounds pretty lame. You're going to have to try a [color=#3b78e2][i]lot[/i][/color] harder if you want to get me there.

nodes.text: As Viv and her friends walk off, James elbows you.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: We lost the sale, but on the bright side, that girl's totally into you.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: We'll have a dance floor, and I've heard we're also getting a disco ball.

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Hee hee. Well, I `do` love to dance.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hee hee. Well, I [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] love to dance.

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Well, maybe I'll give your party a chance... And I just might bring some of my friends.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Great! See you there!
As Viv and her friends walk off, James elbows you.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Nice. She's totally into you.
You and James walk off, leaving the Monarch Prep girls to sunbathe.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Okay, I don't see any other girls on the beach.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Then it's time we try getting off the beach.
You and James head into town...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Look, there's another group of girls. You take point on this.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Ahem, um, excuse me, Miss. My name is $USR, and we're with the MAN fraternity organizing a party tonight.

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Hee hee... I'm Viv. Er, Vivian. But you can call me Viv. Nice to meet you.

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: I think I saw you and your friends earlier at the swimsuit contest. Pretty fun.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Oh! Well. Uh. Great!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Would you and your friends like to come to our party? It's starting in a little less than an hour.

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: I don't know... We already had dinner reservations...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: So skip them! This party's going to be much better.

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Why?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Because we've got...

nodes.prompt: What's so great about your party?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What's so great about your party?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: It'll be the hottest party on the island, and all `totally free!` No cover at all!
nodes.text_bbcode: It'll be the hottest party on the island, and all [color=#e23b3b][i]totally free![/i][/color] No cover at all!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: No cover charge?! That means it's going to be `totally crowded` and filled with riff raff!
nodes.text_bbcode: No cover charge?! That means it's going to be [color=#3b78e2][i]totally crowded[/i][/color] and filled with riff raff!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: But maybe there will be boys...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Penny, this isn't Monarch Prep. There are boys `everywhere!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Penny, this isn't Monarch Prep. There are boys [color=#3b78e2][i]everywhere![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Oh. Right.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Sorry, boys. But we're not interested.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Exclusive, huh?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yeah, only the best of the best are being hand-selected for this.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Sounds great!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess we can make time for it.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Great. See you girls there.
You look around the beach, and spot DUDE and MAN brothers talking to every girl in sight!

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: A disco ball! I promise!

nodes.speaker: Fred
nodes.text: Come to `our` party! I'll let you wear my sunglasses!
nodes.text_bbcode: Come to [color=#e23b3b][i]our[/i][/color] party! I'll let you wear my sunglasses!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: This place is getting tapped out. We better try farther up the beach...
A sprint down the beach later...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Finally! Looks like no one's gotten to this side of the beach.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: There's a group of girls over there!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Hey, stop hogging the sun screen.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I have delicate skin!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Girls, girls. Just relax and soak up the sun! The sun's almost down, anyway.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Any amount of sunlight can give you wrinkles.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Hey, those girls look familiar... I think Dontae was hitting on one of them at the Valentine's Day mixer OMG threw.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Great, so you already know what will impress them! Let's go!
You and James walk up to the girls.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Hey, ladies. Can we interest you in a party tonight?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Sure!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Hold on a second. We could go to any club here tonight. What's so great about `your` party?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hold on a second. We could go to any club here tonight. What's so great about [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] party?

nodes.prompt: What's so great about your party?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What's so great about your party?

nodes.speaker: Jasmine
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Think about it... Would you rather sulk here on the beach, or go to a `crazy` party and make out with some other guy?
nodes.text_bbcode: Think about it... Would you rather sulk here on the beach, or go to a [color=#e23b3b][i]crazy[/i][/color] party and make out with some other guy?

nodes.speaker: Jasmine
nodes.text: I guess he `does` deserve it...
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess he [color=#3b78e2][i]does[/i][/color] deserve it...

nodes.speaker: Monica
nodes.text: Yeah, that would teach him a lesson.

nodes.speaker: Jasmine
nodes.text: All right, boys. We'll come to your party.

nodes.speaker: Monica
nodes.text: Yay! We better start getting ready!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: But the party's not for another hour...

nodes.speaker: Monica
nodes.text: Exactly! We've only got an hour to get ready!

nodes.speaker: Jasmine
nodes.text: See you guys there.
The girls wave and head off to their hotel.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: That wasn't so bad. Who should we talk to now?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: We're in a competition called 'King of Spring Break', and this party's going to be on TV!

nodes.speaker: Jasmine
nodes.text: Great, so everyone at home can see me without Jason? Then they're `totally` going to know that he cheated on me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Great, so everyone at home can see me without Jason? Then they're [color=#3b78e2][i]totally[/i][/color] going to know that he cheated on me!

nodes.speaker: Monica
nodes.text: Jas, calm down...

nodes.speaker: Jasmine
nodes.text: Stupid frat boys...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Er... On behalf of all fraternity brothers, we apologize for his behavior.

nodes.speaker: Jasmine
nodes.text: Sorry, that's not good enough. There's no `way` we're showing up at your party.
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry, that's not good enough. There's no [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] we're showing up at your party.

nodes.speaker: Monica
nodes.text: Are you sure? But...

nodes.speaker: Jasmine
nodes.text: Monica! `We're not going!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Monica! [color=#3b78e2][i]We're not going![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Monica
nodes.text: All right, all right.
Jasmine storms off, and the other girls follow her.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Let's hope the next time we talk to some girls it goes better than that...

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: It's over... It's all over.

nodes.speaker: Brett
nodes.text: Like I was saying, you guys are total losers!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I really let the team down...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Hey, don't beat yourself up about it. We'll get 'em tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yeah... I hope so.

nodes.title: Day 2
nodes.subtitle: Can you be King of the Party?

nodes.text: The next day...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Aloha! Welcome back to the 'King of Spring Break' challenge!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Today, we're going to test our fraternities on what just might be the most important aspect of spring break...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Partying!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: We set both the frats up with parties at opposite ends of the beach, and now we're sending them out to hit the streets and invite girls.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: The rules are simple... The frat with the most girls at their party wins this round!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Okay, you heard him, let's split up and turn on the charm.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: $USR, you're with me. This should be easy!
And so...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Hey! There's a group of girls over there playing volleyball! Volleyball players are hot. Ergo, let's invite them.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I get what you're saying.

nodes.speaker: Jasmine
nodes.text: Ready, Monica? I...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Excuse me, ladies. We'd like to invite you to a party our fraternity is throwing tonight.

nodes.speaker: Monica
nodes.text: Uh oh...

nodes.speaker: Jasmine
nodes.text: Frat boys? My boyfriend's a frat boy...

nodes.speaker: Jasmine
nodes.text: `And last night I caught him making out with another girl!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]And last night I caught him making out with another girl![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jasmine
nodes.text: So why should we go to your party?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: If you come to our party, you'll get a chance to...

nodes.prompt: If you come to our party, you'll get a chance to...

options.label: Be on a reality TV show.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: If you come to our party, you'll get a chance to...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: DUDE's got an early lead, but MAN's still got a shot to catch up!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Okay, now, by audience applause... Let's see who our winners are.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Let's hear it for DUDE!
There's a smattering of applause...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: And for MAN!
The girls cheer and scream!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: There you have it. MAN takes a decisive victory!

nodes.speaker: Brett
nodes.text: Rigged.
Runway Champion!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: We won!
The girls cheer and scream!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: And for MAN!
There's a smattering of applause...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Well, there you have it. DUDE wins this round.

nodes.speaker: Brett
nodes.text: Hah! I knew we'd win.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Don't worry, it's still anyone's game!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: And speaking of which, it's time for our next event!
After a quick change...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: And now as the day's winding down, we've got just one event left for today... What spring break would be complete without a little football on the beach?

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Okay, guys. We should have this one, no problem.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Right!

nodes.speaker: Adrian
nodes.text: Oh yeah?

nodes.speaker: Brett
nodes.text: Let's see what you've got.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: So that's it for day one of 'King of Spring Break'!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: The competition is already heating up, and we've got lots more for you tomorrow!
You stand up straight and salute!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Well, I'm not sure what that had to do with this contest, but, um, we appreciate your patriotism.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Boo! Flex!
You rest your chin on your fist and kneel on one knee.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: An interesting choice to reference classical art.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Hee hee!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: It's a good thing for $USR that this crowd has a sense of humor.
You raise your arms up and flex as hard as you can! The crowd goes wild!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Hot!

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Oh my!
You freeze!

nodes.speaker: Brett
nodes.text: Choke!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Okay, buddy, you're at the end of the runway... Just... Turn around and come back now, okay?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Ugh... I totally blew it!
You all head over to the runway where the DUDEs are already strutting to the applause of the girls.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Don't forget, you've got to come up with something cool to do when you get to the end of that runway. Girls love that kind of thing.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Okay! We've seen what DUDE can do. Now, let's see the men from MAN!
James struts out on the catwalk, gets to the end, and spins around twice. Then he points at the girls in the front and blows them each a kiss!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Eee!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: There's a man who knows how to win over the laaadies!
James winks at them and walks back.
Then Dontae takes the stage...

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Ladies!
The girls giggle and cheer!
Then Chuck goes out and flexes. The girls scream! Then it's your turn!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Here goes...
You get to the end of the runway and...

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Exactly! And I `don't have any confidence!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Exactly! And I [color=#e23b3b][i]don't have any confidence![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: There's no way I'm going out there.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Okay, okay.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Great, we're down a man, and it's our turn... I hope we can pull this off.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Fun? You think this is fun?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: It's `funny!` And everyone out there will think so too. You'll be a hit!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's [color=#e23b3b][i]funny![/i][/color] And everyone out there will think so too. You'll be a hit!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yeah! You just have to stop taking it so seriously. I mean, everyone's here to have a good time. Why not make a joke out of it?

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Come on, suit up!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Fine...

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: I look totally goofy.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Exactly. It's all just for fun, and goofy swim trunks let them know that you aren't taking this too seriously.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Heh. Maybe you're right.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Now, come on. Go have fun.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Let's do this.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I'm... Losing my grip!

nodes.speaker: Brett
nodes.text: Give it up! Adrian hasn't even broken a sweat!

nodes.speaker: Adrian
nodes.text: Adrian could do this `all day!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Adrian could do this [color=#e23b3b][i]all day![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Uuggnnnhhh...

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: $USR, don't let us all down!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Yeah, come on, man!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: It's... No... Use!
Your strength gives out, and you and the other guys on your team go flying into the mud pit!

nodes.speaker: Brett
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! Losers.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: And there you have it, spring breakers! The men of DUDE have triumphed over MAN in this first challenge!

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Oh yeah?
Suddenly, Hawk Gunner strides up, followed by camera men!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Hey, chill, man! Save it for the competition!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Heh. Nice one, $USR.

nodes.speaker: Brett
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. Laugh it up now. We'll see who has the last laugh once the competition starts!

nodes.speaker: Fred
nodes.text: I hope you're all ready to look like total jokes on national television!

nodes.speaker: Brett
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! Can't even think of a comeback, huh? Pathetic.

nodes.speaker: Fred
nodes.text: Why did you even bother showing up? You're just going to look like total jokes.

nodes.title: Day 1
nodes.subtitle: Can you be King of the Beach?

nodes.text: A few hours and one flight later, you and the rest of the MAN fraternity land in Hawaii!

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: The sand, the ocean, and girls in bikinis... Spring break is finally here!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Best spring break ever...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: And we're just getting started.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Yeah, what's the deal with this 'King of Spring Break' show?

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Over this way.
You and the rest of the guys head over to a huge stage with a sign reading, 'Who Will Be The King of Spring Break?'
Around the stage, a crowd is gathering. On the stage, several other guys are standing around waiting.

nodes.speaker: Brett
nodes.text: Hey, you must be our 'competition'.

nodes.speaker: Adrian
nodes.text: Heh heh... Looks like it's not going to be much of a challenge at all.

nodes.speaker: Fred
nodes.text: Yeah, what a bunch of wimps.

nodes.speaker: Todd
nodes.text: We could take 'em with our hands tied behind our backs.

nodes.speaker: Jake
nodes.text: You guys should just go home!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Hey, I'm James. Let's get this competition off to a friendly start. We're the Mu Alpha Nu fraternity.

nodes.speaker: Adrian
nodes.text: MAN? More like, 'We all need a tan'!

nodes.speaker: Brett
nodes.text: Ha ha! Yeah, you guys are lame. I hope you're ready to get crushed by Delta Upsilon Delta Epsilon.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: So pack your bags, boys. The flight leaves tonight!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Awesome! I knew we could count on you!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Lame. Lame, man.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Sorry, not my thing.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Well, I guess we'll see you later.
And so...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Honey, it's so nice to have you home.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yep! Can't wait to kick back and look up my old friends.
You call Howard's house...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Princess Katherine's Castle, can I help you?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Hey, Kay. Can you put Howard on the phone?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Nope, can't do it. He's not here. And I'm actually telling the truth. He and all of his dumb friends went to Hawaii for Spring Break.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Oh... Okay, thanks.
You hang up the phone.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Maybe I'll try Hector's cell.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Party headquarters, can I help you?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Hey man! I'm back in town. Want to hang out?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh, sorry man! I would, but I'm in Hawaii.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Is `everyone` in Hawaii?
nodes.text_bbcode: Is [color=#e23b3b][i]everyone[/i][/color] in Hawaii?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Everyone who's anyone, anyway. Well, got to go. There's a pie eating contest I `don't` want to miss. Later!
nodes.text_bbcode: Everyone who's anyone, anyway. Well, got to go. There's a pie eating contest I [color=#e23b3b][i]don't[/i][/color] want to miss. Later!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: At least I can watch some TV.
And so...

nodes.speaker: Television
nodes.text: Welcome to our 'King of Spring Break' special! Let's see some of our happy contestants now!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Is that Bryce surfing?
And later...

nodes.speaker: Television
nodes.text: That was fun! Now we'll get back to our 'Cause of Death: Can You Stop The Killer' marathon!
And even later...

nodes.speaker: Television
nodes.text: Are you still watching? Don't you have anything better to do?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Huh? This is getting weird. I miss the good old days of high school when watching TV made you more popular...
Well, this certainly was a nice, relaxing trip for $USR... Too bad everyone's living it up in Hawaii!
So if you want something a little more exciting, you're going to have to go where the party is and join that Spring Break trip!

args.text: Try again to get a better ending!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: But you made the football team, and MAN needs football players!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: We just got onto the reality show 'King of Spring Break'! We'll be going head to head against another fraternity in Hawaii!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Hawaii?! That's the best news I've heard all quarter!

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: We really lucked out. The winning fraternity gets $20,000!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: So what do you need me for?

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: One of the events is football. I hear you're a star player, so I'm, ahem, willing to extend MAN membership to you if you'll come help us in Hawaii.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: You'll have all the responsibilities and privileges of a full-fledged brother! Including a share in that prize money if we win!

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Just think about what MAN can do with that kind of money! And whatever we do, you'd be a part of it.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: So, what do you say? Are you in?

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: That's what I thought you'd say.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: We just got onto the reality show 'King of Spring Break'! We'll be going head to head against another fraternity in Hawaii!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Hawaii?! That's the best news I've heard all quarter!

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: And the best part is, the winners get $20,000!

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Just think about what MAN can do with that kind of money!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Nice!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: So what are you doing?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I guess I'm just going home, unless...
Suddenly, James throws open your door! He runs in, followed by Chuck.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: $USR, Bryce, forget your spring break plans.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Done.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: $USR, I need you to come with me! I mean, we all need you.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: MAN needs you.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Tina planned a big trip for the OMG girls, so Beth's going to Tahiti. No boys allowed.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: That sucks for you.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yeah, but I want her to have fun.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Raven doesn't really do the spring break thing... She and the other poetry majors are going to a secluded cabin in the woods to focus on their art.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Intense.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yeah, no boyfriends allowed.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Lisa's already filming her next movie... Some kind of horror film.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Killer.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Exactly. At least it's not another romance movie. But she's stuck doing it all month in Alaska, and it's a closed set.
Welcome to Surviving High School's King of Spring Break special!
Your character from the Football Mega Pack is headed for his first Spring Break college trip!
Ready for some fun in the sun?
Time to find out!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Hey, $USR. You look like a guy who's ready for Spring Break.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yeah, finals were brutal.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: But now it's time to recover. What are you up to? Spending time with your girl?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Unfortunately not.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Why not?

options.label: Lisa's got another film in progress.

nodes.prompt: This is ;sudden death overtime;, so the first team to score wins. Do whatever it takes to score!
In overtime, `the first team to score wins`, so don't let them get a touchdown!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Let's see if they can keep up that momentum at our next event and turn this into a winning streak!
The crowd cheers!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: So now we're going to give the guys a few minutes to get cleaned up and change...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: So they can be ready for our first annual King of Spring Break Swimsuit Contest!

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: We're judging a bikini contest?

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Nope, you're `participating` in a bikini contest. Well, a swimsuit contest, anyway.
nodes.text_bbcode: Nope, you're [color=#e23b3b][i]participating[/i][/color] in a bikini contest. Well, a swimsuit contest, anyway.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Who says those contests are just for girls? Right, ladies?
The girls cheer.

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Turnabout's fair play!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Let's see if these guys can work the runway!
You and the rest of the guys are hustled into one corner to get ready...
A few minutes later, everyone has changed into their swim trunks... Except Dontae.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Are we really doing this?

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: I don't know about this, guys. I'm not exactly the most athletic guy here... And... Oh no. Oh no.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: This must be a mistake... Where are my swim trunks? The ones in my suit case are bright pink and covered with bunnies and unicorns!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Bunnies and unicorns?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Oh, right. Heh... A little joke I played when Dontae's luggage was unattended... They warn you about watching your bags all the time at the airport...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Bryce, this is no time for practical jokes! There's $20,000 up for grabs!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: I didn't think something like this was going to happen!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: I can't do it.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Hey! No more of that quitter talk! We don't all hit the gym five days a week and eat a straight protein diet for nothing, right?

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: You go to the gym five days a week?! Okay, now I'm `definitely` not going out there.
nodes.text_bbcode: You go to the gym five days a week?! Okay, now I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]definitely[/i][/color] not going out there.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Hey, we can do this! It's all about...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: We'll see you back on the beach bright and early tomorrow morning to find out!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Aaaand, we're done. That's good television.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: But it's not over yet! We've still got two craaaazy events lined up to finish off this competition!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Ready to find out what's in store next for these frat brothers?
Hawk begins walking down the beach, still talking into the cameras, as the rest of you follow...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Well, what Hawaiian vacation would be complete without a `luau?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, what Hawaiian vacation would be complete without a [color=#e23b3b][i]luau?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Hawk turns a corner, and you're at a luau! As you walk in, girls in grass skirts place leis around your necks.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Cool.

nodes.speaker: Adrian
nodes.text: Flowers are for girls. Keep those off of me.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: And you can't have a luau without some food...
Hawk sweeps aside a curtain and reveals two huge, roasted pigs!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: So up next, we've got an eating contest! First frat to finish their pig wins!

nodes.speaker: Adrian
nodes.text: Yes.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: We've got this. We've got this. Just don't think about all the empty calories and hours at the gym...

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Hey! $USR! Good luck!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Uh... Thanks!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Oh man, I told you! Viv's here, and she's totally into you!

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Focus up, guys. We've got a pig to eat.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: All right, contestants. Ready? Set? Go!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Wow, Viv, you came all the way out here to see $USR, huh?

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: I... Happened to be around.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Sure, sure. You kids have fun.
James gives you a discreet thumbs up and walks off.

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Uh, $USR, what's he talking about?

options.label: He thinks you're hitting on me.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: All right, fans. That's it! It's over! We're ready to crown the King of Spring Break!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Let's see how our two fraternities have stacked up...
Hawk pulls back another curtain revealing a scoreboard.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: For those of you who don't know me, I'm Hawk Gunner, star of 'A Kiss to Remember', and now the host of 'King of Spring Break'!
Hawk turns to the cameras...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: We've got two rival fraternities both ready to put it all on the line and see which one will be crowned the King of Spring Break!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: We've got three intense days of competition... Seven crazy events to see who deserves to win the crown.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: And two fraternities ready to fight over the title... `And` our grand prize of... `$20,000!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And two fraternities ready to fight over the title... [color=#e23b3b][i]And[/i][/color] our grand prize of... [color=#e23b3b][i]$20,000![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Hawk turns to the crowd of people surrounding the stage...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Our two teams will be earning points over the next three days for each of the challenges...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: And their total scores will be added up to see who the big winner is. So it's not over till it's over!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: But we'll let you know who the champions of each event are, just to keep it interesting.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: So are you ready to see the battle for the beach?
The crowd cheers!

nodes.speaker: Melania
nodes.text: Woo! Spring break! Woo!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: All right, then! Let's get this started! Today's challenge is to see who will reign as the kings of the beach!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: First up, everyone on spring break knows that no trip to the beach is complete without a little friendly tug-of-war!
Hawk gestures over to a cleared space with a long rope stretched over a mud pit!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Gulp!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Okay, guys, we got this. I know they look big, but we've got half the football team here.

nodes.speaker: Viv

nodes.text: You're exaggerating. She was just being friendly. Come on, we better check on the rest of the party.

nodes.text: No... I don't believe it. I mean, maybe we weren't great at selling this party, but this is ridiculous!
